name: Seed Junky | 1g Pre-Roll | Magic Marker
description: Magic Marker is a strong Indica that has a sweet gassy aroma, complimented with a subtle hint of lime. Magic Marker will quickly work its magic and transform a stressful day into a euphoric relaxing night, making this strain great for night time use.
